evidence_status: Exploratory; the separate CartPole reference missed its fixed learning-gain gate and remains failed.
comparison_definition: Predeclared raw native reward primary: mean adapt-minus-scratch across six cases within each source seed, then median of three seed means; all target arms must finish safely.
replay_scope: Read-only verification of retained hashes, reward sums, counts and first64 prefixes. Native replay pass metadata is checked; no new native replay or neural optimizer replay is performed by this analysis.
descriptive_caveat: Non-primary contrasts, endpoint received-light window means and probe maxima are descriptive diagnostics, not new performance gates. No results were selected or tuned.
light_window_caveat: Window lux means use delivered light at each .1s macro endpoint weighted by macro duration; they are descriptive endpoint summaries, not the physics-substep reward integral.
requested_action_caveat: Posthoc descriptive only. A quiet request does not imply zero actual effort, no current, or no physical motion.
